1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi Ni iya Dawidi.

2.text: Hahirwa uwita ku bakene,Uwiteka azamukiza ku munsi w'ibyago.

3.text: Uwiteka azamurinda amukize,kandi azahirwa ari mu isi,Kandi ntumuhe abanzi be kumugirira uko bashaka.

4.text: Uwiteka azamwiyegamiza ahondobereye ku buriri,Ni wowe umubyukiriza uburiri iyo arwaye.

5.text: Naravuze nti “Uwiteka umbabarire,Ukize ubugingo bwanjye kuko nagucumuyeho.”

6.text: Abanzi banjye banyifuriza nabi bati“Azapfa ryari ngo izina rye ryibagirane?”

7.text: Kandi umwe muri abo iyo aje kunsura aba anshunga,Umutima we ukiyuzuriza inama mbi,Agasohoka akabivuga.

8.text: Abanyanga bose bamvugira mu byongorerano,Bangira inama zo kungirira nabi.

9.text: Bati “Indwara ikomeye imubayeho akaramata,Noneho ubwo aryamye ntazabyuka ukundi.”

10.text: Kandi incuti yanjye y'amagara nizeraga nagaburiraga,Ni yo imbanguriye umugeri.

11.text: Ariko wowe ho Uwiteka umbabarire umbyutse,Kugira ngo mbiture.

12.text: Iki ni cyo kimenyesha yuko unyishimira,Ni uko umwanzi wanjye atavugiriza impundu kunesha.

13.text: Kandi jyeweho unkomereza gukiranuka kwanjye,Kandi unshyira imbere yawe iteka ryose.

14.text: Uwiteka Imana y'Abisirayeli ahimbazwe,Uhereye kera kose ukageza iteka ryose.Amen kandi Amen.
